'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Erin Winings DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Erin Winings]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Several (V) boxes on this sheet are hard to read; lines whose (V) mark is unclear are left unlinked and flagged. Lines 58–60 are struck through on the sheet and are shown struck. The sheet lists 60 main-deck lines and 12 shields.

'''Transcription notes''' (left for later cleanup): Line 2 written ''Gift of the Master'' (V): (V) page not confirmed: two Gift Of The Master (V) pages exist; Line 5 written ''Jabba's Haven'' (V?): (V) box unclear; Line 7 written ''Palpatines Quartos'' (V): only a non-(V) page was found for Coruscant: Palpatine's Quarters; no Dark Side wiki page found for Coruscant: Palpatine's Quarters (V); Line 8 written ''Insidious Prisoner'' (V): (V) page not confirmed; Line 9 written ''Private landing Platform'' (V): two Private Platform sites exist (Coruscant, Mustafar); Line 10 written ''Something Special P-T'' (V?): not identified; (V) box unclear; Line 11 written ''Protocal Failure'' (V?): (V) box unclear; Line 16 written ''Galen lightsaber'' (V): weapon word not confirmed (Galen's Lightsaber or Galen's Lightsaber, Vader's Gift); Line 17 written ''Dark Jedi Lightsaber'': not confirmed; Line 19 written ''Fett in Slave I'' (V): not confirmed (Boba Fett In Slave I?); Line 20 written ''Bossk in Buss'': not identified; Line 21 written ''Zuckuss in MH'' (V?): Zuckuss In Mist Hunter?; (V) box unclear; Line 22 written ''Elis in Hintra'' (V): written Hintra; Elis In Hinthra?; Line 23 written ''Victory'' (V): one word; Victory-Class Star Destroyer?; Line 24 written ''Probot'' (V): only a non-(V) page was found for Probot; no Dark Side wiki page found for Probot (V); Line 26 written ''IG Bodyguard Droid'' (V): no Bodyguard Droid page; Line 28 written ''A59'': not identified; Line 29 written ''Nal Hutta'': letters not confirmed; Line 33 written ''4lom w gun'': not expanded (Concussion Rifle not written); Line 34 written ''Trophy of a Kill'' (V): only a non-(V) page was found for Trophy Of A Kill; no Dark Side wiki page found for Trophy Of A Kill (V); Line 35 written ''Imbalance & Kitan Strider'' (V): only a non-(V) page was found for Imbalance & Kintan Strider; no Dark Side wiki page found for Imbalance & Kintan Strider (V); Line 36: rewritten over a strike; Line 38 ''Maul's Sith Infiltrator'': struck through on the sheet, including the (V) box; Line 42 written ''Masterful move & ED'': Masterful Move or Masterful Move & Endor Occupation; ED not confirmed; Line 45 written ''Battle Droid Squad'' (V): only a non-(V) page was found for Battle Droid Squad; no Dark Side wiki page found for Battle Droid Squad (V); Line 46: (V) box unclear on the ditto; Line 48 written ''"'' (V?): ditto of Force Field; (V) box unclear; Line 49 written ''Cyborg Commando'' (V): no Cyborg Commando/Commander page; Line 50 written ''"'' (V?): ditto of line 49; Line 54 written ''Maul YA'': not expanded (Darth Maul, Young Apprentice?); Line 55 written ''"'': ditto of Maul YA; Line 56 written ''"'': ditto of Maul YA; Line 57 written ''Galen SA'' (V): SA not confirmed (Galen Marek, Starkiller?); Line 58 written ''(blank)'': blank or short mark with a (V) tick; no card written; Line 59 ''Maul's Sith Infiltrator'': written over/beside a strike; struck-out area lines 58-60; Line 60 ''A Dark Time For the Rebellion'': struck through on the sheet; Shield 11 written ''Reactor yunh...'': tail not read. Lines in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card or its version could not be identified for certain.
